A type of '''patrol drone''' was produced by the [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing]] company on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hallion]]. In [[3954 BBY]], when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] along with [[Darth Nyriss]]' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Sechel]] infiltrated the [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing plant|droid manufacturing plant]] on the planet, the [[Sentry droid/Legends|patrol droids]] were seen guarding the plant and were easily dispatched by the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
